title: Bring digital flagging to the race vehicle with Garmin Catalyst 2 via MYLAPS X2 RaceLink Club integration
summary: Garmin today announced a real-time high-performance racing solution that allows drivers to quickly view digital flag signals and changing track conditions from the cockpit.
body_markdown:
OLATHE, Kan./Sept. 22, 2026/PR Newswire – Garmin (NYSE: GRMN) today announced a real-time high-performance racing solution that allows drivers to quickly view digital flag signals and changing track conditions from the cockpit. By connecting a[Garmin Catalyst™ 2](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1917956/pn/010-03924-00/) driving performance optimizer and[MYLAPS X2 RaceLink Club](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2037582/) on-board digital flagging device via an[In-car Flagging Y-cable](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2012451/) , motorsports enthusiasts can receive real-time digital flagging in the vehicle, helping them react quicker and race smarter.


*“We’re excited to bring racing enthusiasts the first integrated tech solution that leverages GPS and motorsports expertise from Garmin and racing insights from MYLAPS. For drivers, we know every moment counts and this innovative tool can help them react faster to changing track conditions including weather, safety checks, recovery operations and more.”*
*—Susan Lyman, Garmin Vice President of Consumer Sales and Marketing*


- **Garmin Catalyst 2:** Find the line to faster times with Garmin’s advanced driving performance optimizer1. The innovative, compact device provides real-time audio coaching during track sessions and valuable performance data to review after each session via the Garmin Catalyst app to see where time can be saved.
- **MYLAPS X2 RaceLink Club2:** At select tracks enabled with MYLAPS race control technology, bring on-board flagging to the race vehicle and see live personal and track flag signals directly from race control in the cockpit. Includes a one-year service plan.
- **In-car Flagging Y-cable:** Drivers can connect their X2 RaceLink Club and Garmin Catalyst 2 devices via the Y-cable to gain an enhanced racing experience and react faster to track conditions. Digital flags are displayed on the 3-inch, high resolution LCD screen of the Garmin Catalyst 2.


In addition to the in-car flagging solution, Garmin also offers other exciting products and accessories for motorsports enthusiasts. A[tetherable cage mount accessory](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2022715/) provides an alternative way for drivers to secure their Garmin Catalyst 2 in the vehicle. Garmin also recently introduced the[Garmin Catalyst R1](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/2014665/) racing radar, providing high-performance drivers with more situational awareness, using heads-up indicator lights in the cockpit to help make drivers aware of vehicles approaching from behind.


This is the first MYLAPS integration into the growing Garmin motorsports product category. Garmin acquired the global leader in automated sports timing and tracking systems in 2025.


Available as a **[combined purchase](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1917956/pn/BUNDLE-CAT2-X2RLCLUB)** , the MYLAPS X2 RaceLink Club with a one-year service plan, Garmin Catalyst 2, In-car Flagging Y-cable and cage mount accessory are available together with a suggested retail price of $1,699.99. Drivers can also opt to purchase items separately. Items purchased in the same order may experience separate ship dates; shipment timing for each component will be estimated during order checkout. Learn more about Garmin’s full assortment of motorsports products at[Garmin.com/motorsports](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/automotive/motorsports/) .


Engineered on the inside for life on the outside, Garmin products have revolutionized life for adventurers, athletes, off-road explorers, road warriors and outdoor enthusiasts everywhere. Committed to developing products that enhance experiences, enrich lives and help provide peace of mind, Garmin believes every day is an opportunity to innovate and a chance to beat yesterday.
